features.title: Manage local and remote MCP server definitions
features.summary: Create, edit, enable, connect, disconnect, refresh, and remove bounded stdio or Streamable HTTP server definitions while keeping credentials as references.

configuration.constraints: Native Loader Config list with at most 64 server definitions.
At most 32 environment-variable-to-credential-reference pairs; inline credentials in argv are rejected.
HTTPS URL without embedded username/password, query, or fragment.
Declared preference is currently not user-writable; Host uses the hard-coded parsed default.
Declared integer preference 5 to 600 seconds; currently not user-writable.
Declared boolean preference currently not user-writable.
Declared trimmed text from 1 to 120 characters; currently not user-writable.

failureModes: Malformed URL, inline credential, duplicate tool namespace, or invalid server identifier is rejected.
Client-loaded status never claims a native server health ping was performed.

externalDependencies.boundary: Native MCP client, local stdio process, and remote Streamable HTTP endpoint.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use an in-process local MCP server and injected fake subprocess; do not connect to customer endpoints.

telemetry.testName: records an mcp server start span with the argument count, never argv or environment

features.title: Reference configured MCP servers and tools in the composer
features.summary: Search enabled MCP server namespaces and the current Session's registered MCP tools from @ autocomplete; selection inserts a structured prompt reference without directly executing tools.
reach: expect text "Native client loaded · 1 Host tools registered"
fill textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions" "MCP autocomplete tool context"
fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "@echo"
fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "@e2e"
failureModes: MCP tool suggestions are limited to tools visible to the current Session in the dshx registry.
Selecting a suggestion adds a prompt reference; it does not directly invoke the MCP tool.

verification.testName: decodes MCP tools without letting unrelated long descriptions hide them
maps ranked MCP servers and tools into distinct @ sections
serializes selected MCP entities as explicit, non-path prompt references

features.title: Search curated providers and the MCP Registry
features.summary: Browse curated provider documentation and search the official Registry while handling unavailable or malformed catalog responses safely.
failureModes: Registry failure or oversized response is shown without adding a server.
Only safe HTTPS catalog endpoints are requested.

externalDependencies.boundary: Official MCP Registry HTTP search endpoint.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Intercept the registry request and return fixed success, empty, malformed, and failure fixtures; no public network.

verification.reason: Registry search calls the fixed public endpoint https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io from the Host with no override, so a browser journey would depend on the live network; the curated provider list is shown by the lifecycle journey and the parsing is unit-tested.

telemetry.testName: records an mcp registry search span with the status and result count, never the query

features.title: Authorize remote OAuth servers
features.summary: Discover OAuth metadata, register a client, run PKCE/state validation, exchange and refresh grants, and clear grant state on sign-out.
failureModes: Issuer mismatch, invalid state, expired callback, or token refresh failure never yields a signed-in state.

externalDependencies.boundary: Remote OAuth discovery, authorization, token exchange, and refresh HTTP endpoints.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Inject a fake fetcher and synthetic issuer metadata/tokens; never use real OAuth cookies, browser profiles, or credentials.

verification.testName: follows protected-resource metadata to the authorization server
honours the resource_metadata hint from a 401 challenge
rejects metadata whose issuer differs from the advertised authorization server
falls back to the server origin and rejects plain-HTTP remote endpoints
refuses a server without PKCE S256
registers a public client and builds a PKCE authorization URL
exchanges the code with the verifier and records expiry
rejects a callback from another issuer before exchanging the code
refreshes near expiry, keeps the refresh token, and reports a failed refresh as sign-in needed
accepts only a bare HTTP(S) origin for the callback

features.title: Batch enable, disable and remove MCP servers
features.summary: Registered servers take checkbox selection with ranges and visible-only select-all; enabled or disabled servers change in one pass, and removing a selection always goes through a count-named confirmation that stops its native clients and drops their grants.
failureModes: A server whose enabled state already matches the batch is skipped instead of being written twice.
Removal stops at the first failure and reports it; nothing is removed without the confirmation naming the count.

verification.testName: targets only the selected servers an enable or disable would change

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Batch enable, disable and remove MCP servers renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

ioDelegation.reason: The registry search runs inside createTracedRegistrySearch (src/registry-search-host.ts), which opens the span; this module stays importable by the Client.
Passes globalThis.fetch into createTracedRegistrySearch, which opens the mcp registry search span around each request.
